Guidance.reason: Guidance improved. ACCO now expects flat 2019 sales versus flat to down 3%, and raised the EPS range floor to $1.15 from $1.10.

Revenue.reason: Revenue beat expectations. Second-quarter sales were $518.7 million versus the $494.2 million FactSet consensus.

Product / Users.reason: Underlying volume declined. Comparable sales rose 4.4% because pricing more than offset lower unit volume.

Profits and profitability.reason: Adjusted earnings beat expectations. EPS was $0.36 versus the $0.32 FactSet consensus.
